title: Error-summary click routing has no executed test — only the resolution chain is pinned
detail: The form-errors click handler (preventDefault, step switch, focus) — the r0 double-prefix bug's home — has no executed test: units pin only resolveAnchorTarget; the cited E2E scenario drives a pristine form to confirmation, never a form-errors render.
recommended_fix: Add a form-bug-hunt scenario with stepper:true that lands on a validation-error re-render and clicks an error-summary link, asserting the step switch and field focus.

title: Preflight-hold wiring untested — only the boolean predicate is pinned; oversize E2E runs stepper=off
detail: The r1 dead-end fix's wiring (submit lookup, message scroll, refusal to advance) is untested: the test asserts only the pure predicate, and files/oversize-file.yaml runs stepper=off by suite default, so regressions re-create the hidden-reason dead-end silently.
recommended_fix: Add a files scenario with stepper:true staging an oversize document, asserting Continue holds on the documents step and scrolls the banner or per-file error into view.

title: Analytics-truth synthetic input dispatch on gated Continue has no test at any level
detail: initBrowser isn't exported, so node tests can't reach this dispatch, and the stepper E2E asserts no analytics events — deleting the r1 funnel fix keeps every test green while section_completed silently drops for browser-restored values.
recommended_fix: Assert in the stepper E2E that advancing fires application_form_section_completed, or extract/export the dispatch so a node test pins it.

title: Visited-only progress-segment coloring on form-errors re-render is unpinned
detail: The r1 fix restricting done-segments to visited steps lives inside unexported initBrowser, and no E2E drives a form-errors render with the stepper — a regression to teal-on-unvisited would ship silently.
recommended_fix: In the form-errors stepper E2E scenario, assert segments before the start step lack the stepper-segment-done class.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100% (gating rules, step model, no-JS SSR pins, submit path, analytics contract covered; 58 node + 1149 server tests green). P1 ~86% (5 of 7 rows full; anchor-click glue and preflight-hold wiring partial). Overall ≥80% including P2/P3 gaps.
recommended_fix: Raise to PASS by adding one form-errors stepper E2E (anchor click, segment colors) and one stepper-on oversize-file hold scenario; optionally pin the analytics-truth dispatch.
